meta.name: monetizing-innovation
meta.description: Design products and pricing around validated willingness to pay, from Ramanujam & Tacke's "Monetizing Innovation". Use when the user mentions "pricing", "how much should we charge", "willingness to pay", "pricing page", "packaging", "freemium vs free trial", "are we leaving money on the table", "nobody buys at this price", "price increase", or "good-better-best". Also trigger when designing or auditing pricing and packaging, validating willingness to pay before building, segmenting customers by value, or choosing between subscription, usage-based, and freemium models. Covers price-before-product, willingness-to-pay talks, the four failures (feature shock, minivation, hidden gem, undead), leader/filler/killer packaging, and behavioral pricing. For offers and guarantees, see hundred-million-offers. For what customers value, see jobs-to-be-done.

copy.tagline_en: Design product pricing and packaging based on validated willingness to pay
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing or auditing product pricing and packaging

howto.what: Claude 会帮你设计产品和定价，基于客户愿意支付的真实价格。它会引导你在产品开发前测试价格，避免四种定价失败，并帮你把功能打包成不同档次。
howto.when: 当你提到“定价”、“愿意支付”、“免费试用 vs 免费增值”等关键词，或要求设计定价方案、验证客户付费意愿时触发。

say.text: 我们这款新软件应该怎么定价？
say.note: Claude 会引导你进行愿意支付测试。

say.text: 帮我检查一下现在的定价有没有问题。
say.note: Claude 会分析四种定价失败模式。

say.text: 如何把功能分成好、更好、最好三个档次？
say.note: Claude 会教你区分领导者、填充者和杀手功能。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you design products and pricing based on validated willingness to pay. It guides you to test price before building, avoid four monetization failures, and package features into tiers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'pricing', 'willingness to pay', 'freemium vs free trial', or ask to design pricing, validate willingness to pay, or segment customers.

say_en.text: How should we price our new software?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through willingness-to-pay testing.

say_en.text: Check if our current pricing has issues.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the four monetization failures.

say_en.text: How to split features into good-better-best tiers?
say_en.note: Claude explains leader, filler, and killer features.
